### Proposed changes

Describe the use case and detail of the change. If this PR addresses an issue on GitHub, make sure to include a link to that issue using one of the [supported keywords](https://docs.github.com/en/github/managing-your-work-on-github/linking-a-pull-request-to-an-issue) in this PR's description or commit message.

### Checklist

Before creating a PR, run through this checklist and mark each as complete:

- [ ] I have read the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/nginx/kubernetes.nginx.org/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I have signed the [F5 Contributor License Agreement (CLA)](https://github.com/f5/f5-cla/blob/main/docs/f5_cla.md).
- [ ] If applicable, I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] I have run the [checks](https://github.com/nginx/kubernetes.nginx.org/blob/main/README.md#checks) locally and they pass.
- [ ] If my change affects the rendered page, I have looked at it in a browser — the checks are static readers and cannot see layout.
- [ ] I have updated any relevant documentation ([`README.md`](https://github.com/nginx/kubernetes.nginx.org/blob/main/README.md)).
